name: Valuation and Financing in Mergers & Acquisitions
description: This course focuses on the financial and valuation aspects of Mergers and Acquisitions. It covers the fundamentals of business valuation and the financial aspects of M&As, including financing methods, synergy valuation, control premiums, and performance outcomes. It also includes financial restructuring of organisations, private equity and leveraged buyout considerations.
